module: Unit tests of the non-shipping NavigationObserver module (duplicate_navigation / conflicting_navigation classification, caller attribution, single warning, reset). Not an API for modders: file run by the test framework.

testIdenticalRequestsAreDuplicate.desc: Checks that two identical requests (route, scope, params, options) are classified duplicate_navigation.

testDifferentRouteIsConflict.desc: Checks that a different route gives conflicting_navigation.

testDifferentParamsIsConflict.desc: Checks that different effective parameters give conflicting_navigation.

testDifferentScopeIsConflict.desc: Checks that a different scope gives conflicting_navigation.

testDifferentOptionsIsConflict.desc: Checks that different router options give conflicting_navigation.

testBeginAttemptAttributesExternalCaller.desc: Checks that beginAttempt ignores the router's internal frames and attributes the external Lua caller.

testBeginAttemptFallsBackToBridgeUnknown.desc: Checks the fallback to "bridge/unknown" when no Lua frame is available.

testPreemptedAttemptIsReportedOnlyOnce.desc: Checks that a preempted attempt is reported only once.

testResetClearsCounterAndReportState.desc: Checks that reset() resets the counter, the current attempt and the deduplication state.

testMissingAttemptsAreNotReported.desc: Checks that reportPreemption does nothing if one of the attempts is missing.

testSelfPreemptionIsNotReported.desc: Checks that an attempt never preempts itself.
